question: Who decides when the Ridge Line reopens in spring, and on what check?
angle: The snow belief is a rider's account; the record names one signature after one inspection.
promise: You will know what riders believe and what the record shows about the reopening.

hook.text: Riders say the snow decides. The record names a signature.
hook.payoff: Steps 1 and 2 set the belief against the documented check.

wontSay: That the 2026 date can be predicted
That snow never delays the sign-off

sources.title: Council minutes, 12 March 2019
sources.supports: the drainage engineer signs the reopening after an inspection

sources.title: Ridge Line maintenance plan
sources.supports: the inspection is a drainage check

sources.title: Reopening log 2016-2025
sources.supports: one reopening date per year, without causes

sources.title: Rider forum thread
sources.supports: riders say the route reopens when the snow melts

reservations: The forum thread is a rider's account, not an official source.
basisReason: No comparable spring piece has been published yet.

chosen.note: Mix 1 and 3: open on the snow belief, then show the engineer's sign-off.

plan.title: The snow belief
plan.goal: Pose the rider belief that the snow decides, so the question is clear.

plan.title: What the plan checks
plan.goal: Show that the plan names a drainage inspection as the check.

plan.title: Who signs
plan.goal: Name the engineer's sign-off as recorded in the council minutes.

plan.title: Ten springs on record
plan.goal: Show the logged dates without explaining any single year.

plan.title: What we cannot tell yet
plan.goal: Say that 2026 is undocumented and invite riders to share the dates they know.

beforeWriting: Open the council minutes and confirm the sign-off wording.
Find out whether the logged 2020 date was a delay or a plan.
